faq.label: Frequently asked questions
faq.title: Quick answers before you get started.
faq.install: Do I need to install any software?
faq.installAnswer: No. OptiFix runs in your browser, so you can access it from a computer, tablet, or phone with an internet connection.
faq.roles: What is the difference between Administrator and Technician?
faq.rolesAnswer: The administrator configures the workshop, users, and modules. The technician works on orders, updates diagnostics, and reviews daily operations.
faq.whatsapp: How do I contact a client through WhatsApp?
faq.whatsappAnswer: From the order or client record, the app prepares a message with the current details and status to open a conversation directly.
faq.dataAnswer: During the demonstration, the app uses JSON Server and local backup. Production storage depends on each workshop's selected infrastructure.
